name: utf8-length-too-many
source: local a,b,c=utf8.len("a"); assert(a==1 and b==nil and c==nil)

name: next-too-many
source: local key,value,extra=next({marker=42}); assert(key=="marker" and value==42 and extra==nil)

name: close-single
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local ok=coroutine.close(co); assert(ok)

name: close-pair
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local ok,err=coroutine.close(co); assert(ok and err==nil)

name: close-error
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() error({marker=true}) end); local status,reason=coroutine.resume(co); assert(not status and type(reason)=="table"); local ok,err=coroutine.close(co); assert(not ok and type(err)=="table")

name: close-too-many
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local ok,err,extra=coroutine.close(co); assert(ok and err==nil and extra==nil)

name: length-wrapper
source: local function read() return utf8.len("a") end; local count=read(); assert(count==1)

name: length-wrapper-too-many
source: local function read() return utf8.len("a") end; local a,b,c=read(); assert(a==1 and b==nil and c==nil)

name: wrap-results
source: local fn=coroutine.wrap(function() return 1,"two",true end); local a,b,c=fn(); assert(a==1 and b=="two" and c==true)

name: wrap-yield-results
source: local fn=coroutine.wrap(function() local a,b=coroutine.yield(1,"two"); assert(a==3 and b=="four"); return 5,"six" end); local a,b=fn(); assert(a==1 and b=="two"); local c,d=fn(3,"four"); assert(c==5 and d=="six")

name: debug-function-info
source: local function fn(a:number):number return a end; local count,vararg=debug.info(fn,"a"); assert(count==1 and not vararg)

name: debug-thread-info
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local source=debug.info(co,0,"s"); assert(source==nil or type(source)=="string")

name: debug-info-alias
source: local info=debug.info; local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local source=info(co,0,"s"); assert(source==nil or type(source)=="string")
